item.title: Fae
item.description: I've been interested in folklore for some time now, from the Kitsune, Yuki-onna, and Kappa as well as others such as the Dryads, Satyr, and Lamia. Fae have topped the list for some time. The elusive beings known as "Fae," which seems to be an umbrella term rather than one that points at a specified subset of creature, are a sort of magical beings tied to nature. item.title: Ada Lovelace
item.description: Augusta Ada King, Countess of Lovelace was known for her work on the Analytical Engine. The general-purpose computer proposed by Charles Babbage. She was an English mathematician and writer. Born as the sole legitimate daughter of Lord Byron, the union of her parents was broken a month after her birth.
